engineering_deviations: Runtime Habitat Lab/Sim 0.3.3, not original 0.1.7; modern navmesh construction can differ.
Depth is metric axial distance (0..10m), instead of normalized depth, before the private guard.
No shortest-path/oracle-progress sensor enters policy inputs.
Optional depth guard and loop termination belong to the agent method, not official metric success.
An additional decision budget counts semantic no-ops and depth rejections.
depth30 protocol is a separately named sensor variant.
